notes.title: Small important update: Career save fix.
notes.content:
Billy The Kid (a fantastic Paper Jam! player) brought it to our attention that the career mode wasn't saving correctly after the last update. Unfortunately, a gremlin had got in and broken difficulty levels.

We're pleased to say that this is now fixed. The only downside is that any previously saved career will be automatically reset to 'Medium' difficulty level when you try to continue. Apologies if you are either an easy level or bard level player - you will need to restart your career to continue playing on those levels (a new career will not lose unlocked things, but it will mean starting from level 1 again sorry).

Thankfully, the next time you make a career game, it will save the settings correctly and the bug has been well and truly squashed.  We also fixed screen fading, which had its own (now evicted) gremlin. 

Have fun!

notes.title: Minor update.
notes.content:
Thanks to your amazing support and bug reporting as we continue to make Paper Jam! even better! Here's the latest round of issue fixes. We've also included a new rain effect that will randomly occur at night time, just to add a little more atmosphere!

Full list of changes:
Fixed some speech bubbles not appearing during tutorial
Fixed career high score being registered by quick games by accident
Fixed level number on board being affected by quick
Fixed career restart score cheat bug
Fixed level number wrong near the end of each level
Changed bonus word to 'anagram' in bot speak
Fixed incorrectly localized 'anagram found' and 'anagram not found' messages
Corrected mistake in end of tutorial speech (shouldn't assume player solved anagram)
Fixed the tutorial anagram word so it is the same every time (and easy)
Fixed launching into anagram round after losing/restart
Fixed in-game board level number update
Added controller detection to disable grip on index
Added rainy nights
Fixed continue career menu button appearing whenever game started (regardless of career or not)

notes.title: Minor update
notes.content:
Just a small update (v1.3.1). We've given you a bit more time in easy mode to make things easier, fixed the floor level (throwing stuff around is fun, right? But freaky when it goes through the floor!!) and now you can finally skip end of level score counting on Quest via Link. The message board is also fixed - it was doing silly things with the current career level. Finally, the 'unlocked new thing' message should turn to face you now, so it's easier to read. We've also fixed a little graphical glitch with the speech bubble (barely noticeable but it bugged us) where it would appear before it ran its appear animation.

Have fun!

notes.title: Controller detection fix
notes.content:
Thanks for all your help and patience as we ironed out some serious problems with the controller detection on first running the game. Controllers are now properly detected every time. If you encounter any problems with this, please let us know in the pinned bug post of the discussion forums here.

Other changes in this build 1.2.7:
Fixed end game message in quick game.
Fixed hiding of continue career button when there was no career to continue.
Fixed Oculus Quest via Link not allowing skipping of the bonus /score counting at the end of levels.
Fixed Oculus Quest via Link controller detection.
Fixed floor level collision mesh.
